about: Inkling 2 Mini (26B looped MoE, ~3B active, vision, thinking) UD-IQ4_XS with the F16 vision projector on one 24 GB card: the full 262,144-token window with a q8_0 KV cache, no draft model. Unsloth's llama.cpp prebuilt mix (pr-set.json@cfc9ea37, including #386, #400, #401, #402) plus unslothai/llama.cpp#407 (GQA-3 dp4a+half2 banded decode, O(1) contiguous-prefix check, small-batch banded MMA, 128 MiB dense bias cap), #408 (CUDA-graph-safe Q8_1 activation cache + fused RMS_NORM+MUL+Q8_1), and #409 (GGML_OP_ATTN_RES_MIX + Inkling 2 decode kernel fusions). -ub 128, backend sampling (-bs), the vision projector on the CPU to leave room for the cache, one slot, Thinking Machines' recommended sampling. On an RTX 3090 24 GB (including ~1.6 GiB desktop baseline), whole-card VRAM peaked at 21,161 MiB over the 6 gates (92.1 tok/s decode, 772 tok/s prefill).
install: Unsloth's llama.cpp prebuilt mix built from source for sm_86 with Inkling 2 CUDA decode optimizations: git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp llama.cpp-unsloth && git -C llama.cpp-unsloth checkout b12606, then git merge --no-ff, in listed order, every PR commit pinned in https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/blob/cfc9ea3709ca048d21aea67cd34be1eb7cd5cd92/scripts/unsloth/pr-set.json (resolving add/add conflicts with that repo's scripts/unsloth/additive_merge.py as its unsloth-prebuilt.yml does), followed by https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/407/commits/7e0186af3577d8595d3042449f8298439c533230, https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/408/commits/7a5c325338092213c0194bd9849b3d9b32028dba, and https://github.com/unslothai/llama.cpp/pull/409/commits/560e7fd389cca812dabf7097476ecc4a03eccb17 (merged tree b301feeb674402f9c0487967a0259c748fd5a7e9); then cmake -S llama.cpp-unsloth -B llama.cpp-unsloth/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86 -DGGML_CUDA_FA_ALL_QUANTS=ON -DGGML_CUDA_NCCL=OFF -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_OPENSSL=OFF && cmake --build llama.cpp-unsloth/build -j --target llama-server (CUDA 13 toolkit; built in nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 with GCC 11.4)
setup: Not Docker; Linux x86-64 with an NVIDIA driver for CUDA 13. Build llama.cpp-unsloth/ as in install, next to models/, and run from that directory (building inside the nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 image works too). If the CUDA 13 runtime is not on the library path, put libcudart.so.13, libcublas.so.13 and libcublasLt.so.13 in cuda13-runtime/ (for example from NVIDIA's cuda_cudart 13.3 and libcublas 13 redistributables). The launch uses most of a 24 GB card; close other GPU programs first.
